headline: Iran says its new leader made his 1st address, vowing to keep Strait of Hormuz closed
summary: Iranian state media issued a statement attributed to Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei vowing to keep the Strait of Hormuz closed. It also pledged continued attacks on U.S. bases in the region.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil passes. Any disruption there directly affects global energy supply and prices.

source.name: WKU Public Radio | The Public Radio Service of Western Kentucky University

sources.name: WKU Public Radio | The Public Radio Service of Western Kentucky University

why_moved: The statement vows to keep the strait closed and maintain attacks on U.S. bases, prolonging supply disruption risk for oil.
